title: A Registry to Gather Real World Use Data on the Cerene® Cryotherapy Device
official: A Prospective, Observational, Multi-center Study to Gather Real World Use Data on the Effectiveness, Safety, and Site-of-service of the Cerene Device
summary: Channel Medsystems, Inc., the manufacturer of the Cerene® Cryotherapy Device (Cerene), is initiating a prospective, observational registry, the Progress registry, to gather data during real world utilization of the Cerene® Cryotherapy Device (Cerene). The primary objective of this registry is to bridge the gap between clinical results and outcomes achieved and reported during the pivotal study of Cerene and those obtained during its real-world use.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Scheduled for a Cerene treatment
* 25 years of age and older
* Provided informed consent to participate in the registry
* English speaking
* Agrees to complete a survey at specified time points from baseline to 12 Months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Physician discretion
* Vulnerable populations

sites.f: Axia Women's Health / Rubino OB/GYN Group
